ResearchProjectDef.label: creeper
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct creepers: living hive organs that expand creep, feed surrounding hive structures, and produce insect jelly when fully established.

ResearchProjectDef.label: glow pod
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cultivate small bioluminescent glow pods, including dark glow pods when the black hive is present.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deep heater
ResearchProjectDef.description: Dig deep heater vents that tap underground heat through insectoid bioengineering.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hive structure
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build basic hive walls, hive doors, hivestone walls, and insect jelly walls.

ResearchProjectDef.label: jelly farm
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow organic jelly farms that steadily produce insect jelly from established creep.

ResearchProjectDef.label: thornspitter
ResearchProjectDef.description: Raise thornspitter mounds for organic point defense.

ResearchProjectDef.label: burrow walls
ResearchProjectDef.description: Pack dirt, stone, and insectoid secretion into durable burrow walls. Their low flammability makes them far more fire resistant than ordinary hive walls.

ResearchProjectDef.label: large glow pod
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cultivate larger glow pods, including large dark glow pods when the black hive is present.

ResearchProjectDef.label: glow pod formation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow dense glow pod formations, including dark glow pod formations when the black hive is present.

ResearchProjectDef.label: foam pod
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow firefoam pods that burst into flame-retardant foam when fire draws near.

ResearchProjectDef.label: heat pod
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow heat pods that provide local light and warmth for a limited time.

ResearchProjectDef.label: jellyspreader
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow jellyspreaders that convert established creep into soft insect jelly terrain.

ResearchProjectDef.label: tendril farm
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cultivate tendril farms that slowly seed nearby creep with harvestable tendrilmoss.

ResearchProjectDef.label: thorn pod
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow thorn pods that release volleys of sharp chitin when enemies approach.

ResearchProjectDef.label: kemian hive
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build artificial hives that spawn Kemian geneline insectoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: nuchadus hive
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build artificial hives that spawn Nuchadus geneline insectoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: xanides hive
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build artificial hives that spawn Xanides geneline insectoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: glow pod spire
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow towering glow pod spires that can light an area brightly enough for crops.

ResearchProjectDef.label: jelly morpher
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow jelly morphers that refine insect jelly into royal insect jelly.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hivenode
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow hivenodes that nourish nearby insectoid structures and remove their maintenance needs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: petroglypher
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow petroglyphers that reinforce nearby natural rock into hivestone.

ResearchProjectDef.label: staticpod
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow staticpods that generate small amounts of organic electricity.

ResearchProjectDef.label: thornworm
ResearchProjectDef.description: Raise thornworm mounds that unleash rapidly growing chitin thorns.

ResearchProjectDef.label: vilelobber
ResearchProjectDef.description: Raise vilelobber mounds that spit long-range corrosive acid blobs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: royal jellyspreader
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow royal jellyspreaders that enrich insect jelly terrain into royal jelly terrain.

ResearchProjectDef.label: royal jelly wall
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build hard, beautiful, fireproof walls from royal insect jelly.
